Asked my agent (via SSH) what's on the Windows screen. Answer: nothing. That's session 0 — SSH lands in a windowless world. Telekinesis now relays itself into the real desktop via the Task Scheduler. Live: launch calc, click 1+2=, read "3". No pixels. One shell command per verb.
